svg.title: Published reading and personal research
svg.desc: Mac and Android read public website content. On user action, selected text goes to the configured model; each platform uses its own Zotero interface. Research backups store separate versions. The dashed return requires confirmation, does not merge automatically and excludes credentials and local integrity keys.
svg.text: Published reading and personal research
Solid: read or save · Dashed: confirmed restoration
Published website content
Indexes, explanations, collections, citations, PDF sources
Opening content does not restart production analysis
Read-only access
Mac and Android applications
Reading, PDF comparison, favorites, notes and study
Personal data and model settings
stay separate from website production
The user-configured model service
Called only for active study or connection tests
Study sends approved text, not PDFs or images
Mac only: local Zotero
Use authorization granted on that device
Verify the actual archived items and attachments
Android only: Zotero Web API
Configure separate official API authorization
Do not inherit the Mac local authorization
Both platforms: research backups
Separate version storage; confirm before restoring
No automatic merge of concurrent device edits
Separate from Zotero attachment sync and consent
Model keys, login credentials and local integrity keys
are excluded from backups; restore does not resend.
The usage guides state the actual verification scope.
